basic_details.job_title: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Walk in for 67 Faculty and Senior Resident Posts
basic_details.short_information: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) Faculty and Senior Resident Notification 2026 was released on 18 August 2026 on the official website esic.gov.in/recruitments. A total of 67 vacancies have been announced through the ESIC Faculty and Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Senior Resident posts across 28 specialties.

how_to_apply: There is no separate online application submission for this recruitment. The process is as follows:
Download the application form from the official ESIC recruitment page: esic.gov.in/recruitments.
Fill the form completely in the prescribed format only; incomplete applications or applications in any other format will be summarily rejected.
Report at the Academic Block, ESIC Medical College, Sanathnagar, Hyderabad, between 9:00 AM and 10:30 AM on the specialty's scheduled interview date.

Submit the duly filled application at the time of certificate verification on the day of the Walk-in Interview, along with two self-attested passport-size photographs, self-attested copies of certificates/testimonials (age, qualification, experience, research papers/publications), and the original certificates for verification.
Pay the applicable application fee (if any) via the SB Collect online payment system at the venue.
Appear for the interview before the Selection Board.
Queries can be sent to: [email protected]

content_sections.heading: ESIC Faculty and Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The Walk-in Interview schedule is fixed specialty-wise and will not be changed, as stated in the notification. Reporting time on each interview date is 9:00 AM to 10:30 AM. Candidates reporting after the scheduled time will not be allowed to attend the interview process.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Faculty and Senior Resident Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The table below lists all 67 vacancies as per category-wise reservation (SC, ST, OBC, UR, EWS), exactly as given in the official notification. Departments marked with an asterisk () are Super Specialty departments. Note: Vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease based on actual requirement for patient care and NMC requirements. In case of non-availability of Super Specialty Senior Residents (MCh/DM/DrNB) for Super Specialty departments, Senior Residents from the concerned parent Board specialties will be considered.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Faculty and Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The crucial date for determining age limit, work experience, and other eligibility criteria is the date of the Walk-in Interview. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying. Two specific transition-period qualification pathways are mentioned in the notification: As per NMC TEQ dated 14.02.2022, a DNB (Broad or Super Specialty) is equivalent to the corresponding MD/MS or DM/M.Ch qualification when granted at an institution with an attached hospital of 500+ beds; otherwise, one additional year of senior residency in a medical college is required for teaching-post equivalence. Candidates with experience as Associate Professor/Assistant Professor may also apply for the post of Professor/Associate Professor. Such candidates will be considered only if no eligible candidate at the required experience level applies; if selected, they will be appointed at the corresponding lower pay scale on the recommendation of the Selection Board.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Faculty and Senior Resident Salary 2026
content_sections.text: ESIC has adopted a Consolidated Remuneration structure for Contractual Faculty (Super Specialist, Specialist) and Residents/Tutors, as per applicable ESIC Headquarters office memoranda. Consolidated remuneration for cadres other than regular Senior Resident includes NPA@20%, DA@60%, and HRA@27%; a transport allowance is also payable. These amounts are subject to revision with changes in Dearness Allowance rates as per Central Government policy. No private practice is allowed during the tenure of service in ESIC.

rows.consolidated_remuneration: 7th CPC salary at Level-11 (basic pay Rs. 67,700 + DA, NPA, HRA as per rules)
rows.approximate_total_monthly_earnings: Not separately specified in the notification

content_sections.heading: Term of Contract and Security Deposit
content_sections.text: Faculty: initial contract of 1 year, extendable yearly up to a maximum of 3 years or 70 years of age (whichever is earlier), subject to satisfactory performance and requirement. Senior Resident: initial engagement of 1 year, extendable yearly up to 3 years, subject to satisfactory performance and requirement. Senior Resident (1 Yr), against sanctioned strength of Medical Officer: engagement is for 1 year only. Either side may terminate the contract with one month's prior notice, or one month's gross salary in lieu. Selected candidates (Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor/Senior Resident) must deposit Rs. 1,00,000/- as a security deposit at the time of joining, which is forfeited under specific early-exit conditions listed in the notification.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Faculty and Senior Resident Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is based on the candidate's performance in a personal interview before the Selection Board. The selection procedure may be altered at the authority's discretion if a large number of candidates appear. Results are displayed on the ESIC website. Selected candidates must join immediately upon receipt of the offer of appointment; failure to join by the stipulated last date leads to cancellation of appointment, and the next eligible candidate is automatically deemed selected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Faculty and Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 (Walk-in Interview)
content_sections.text: There is no separate online application submission for this recruitment. The process is as follows: Download the application form from the official ESIC recruitment page: esic.gov.in/recruitments. Fill the form completely in the prescribed format only; incomplete applications or applications in any other format will be summarily rejected. Report at the Academic Block, ESIC Medical College, Sanathnagar, Hyderabad, between 9:00 AM and 10:30 AM on the specialty's scheduled interview date. Submit the duly filled application at the time of certificate verification on the day of the Walk-in Interview, along with two self-attested passport-size photographs, self-attested copies of certificates/testimonials (age, qualification, experience, research papers/publications), and the original certificates for verification. Pay the applicable application fee (if any) via the SB Collect online payment system at the venue. Appear for the interview before the Selection Board. Queries can be sent to: [email protected]

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Faculty and Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contractual recruitment drive (Advertisement No. 02/2026, dated 18.08.2026) by ESIC Medical College Hospital, Sanathnagar, Hyderabad, to fill Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Senior Resident posts across 28 specialties through Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 67 vacancies in total (SC: 9, ST: 3, OBC: 16, UR: 33, EWS: 6), spread across Faculty and Senior Resident posts in various specialties.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: There is no online "last date to apply." Instead, candidates must appear for the Walk-in Interview on the specialty-specific date between 24.08.2026 and 31.08.2026, as listed in the Important Dates section.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Qualifications follow the Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations 2025 issued by the NMC. The notification does not list subject-wise qualification details except for specific transition-period provisions for PMR and Critical Care Medicine (ICU); candidates should verify exact requirements from the NMC regulations and official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 69 years for Faculty posts and 45 years for Senior Resident posts, as on the date of the Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: NIL for SC/ST, Female, Ex-servicemen and PH candidates; Rs. 500/- for all other categories, payable online (SB Collect) at the venue.
